title: Python: Add DAO state persistence to disk
description: Part of DAO persistence crash safety (rpl)
close_reason: Already implemented: TwoSlotFilePersistence in dao_persistence.py provides crash-safe disk persistence with two-slot alternation, generation numbers, checksums, and atomic writes. DaoManager is fully integrated - persists TX state before transmission and RX floors before accepting DAOs. 49 tests cover TX/RX survival across restarts, corruption recovery, concurrent writes, and require_crash_safety enforcement.
